<thought>Based on the series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da and the rapidly decreasing intensities (M, M+1 ≈ 8 % of M, M+2 ≈ 0.5 % of M, etc.), the pattern matches the binomial distribution expected from natural ¹³C isotopes in a molecule containing several carbon atoms. No other element shows a distinctive two‑peak (Cl, Br) or multi‑peak pattern here, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
